title: Singleton restriction transport in the explicit subset insertion
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f:Fin r→A, and J an arbitrary integer cochain complex of module sheaves on Spec A. Use the explicit union V, restriction J′, and subset insertion from [def-sc-principal-open-cech-subset-insertion], the section transport from [lem-sc-principal-open-cech-section-transport], and the alternating total from [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex]. Fix degree n and a nonempty subset S of cardinality one, an inclusion D_S≤V, and an equality n=n+1-|S|. Let H forget the global-ring scalar action, L be the natural-indexed tuple row of J′^n, K the tuple double complex, and e:(K^0)^n≅L^0 the extension-by-zero component isomorphism. For s∈J^n(V), define z∈L^0 by transporting s to V, applying the degree-zero restriction alternatingCechZero, and then e.hom, after H. Let t_S be the increasing one-tuple of S. Applying principalSubsetInsertOne to the restriction of s to D_S with the given coefficient-degree transport equals H(e.inv) followed by H of the (0,n) total inclusion, applied to Pi.single t_S (z(t_S)). This statement concerns one singleton only; it asserts no sum over subsets or full augmentation equality.

proof.text: Write S={i} using |S|=1. The increasing enumeration t_S is the one-tuple i, and D_S=D(f_i). Thus the tuple intersection is W=V.ι^{-1}(D_S) and V.ι(W)=D_S. Put M=J^n. In the source section transport, first identify M(V) with M(V.ι(top)); in the subset section transport identify M(D_S) with M(V.ι(W)). The two composites of these open equality maps and the restriction map agree since all maps between the same opens are equal. Apply restrictAppIso_inv_map to the inclusion W≤top to commute the inverse restriction comparison with this presheaf restriction. Apply naturality of the inverse overFunctorEquiv, evaluated on W≤top, to commute the final coefficient equivalence with restriction. This gives the W-coordinate of alternatingCechPresheafZero of the canonically transported section. The restrictScalarsId comparison in alternatingCechZero is the identity on underlying additive groups. Its extension inverse cancels e.hom, so z(t_S) is this coordinate. The equality he identifies the coefficient J^(n+1-|S|) with J^n, and proof irrelevance identifies the given equality map with this transport. Finally |S|-1=0 identifies the insertOne extension inverse and total inclusion with e.inv and the (0,n) total inclusion. Apply Pi.single at t_S and compose these two maps to obtain exactly the asserted equality.

lean.statement:
theorem principalSubsetInsertOne_singleton_augmentation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (J : CochainComplex (Spec (.of A)).Modules ℤ) (n : ℤ)
    (S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}) (h : S.val.card = 1)
    (hl : principalSubsetOpen A r f S.val ≤ principalSubsetUnion A r f)
    (he : n = n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ))
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X n)).obj.obj (op (principalSubsetUnion A r f))) :
    let V := principalSubsetUnion A r f
    let U : Fin r → V.toScheme.Opens := fun i ↦ V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)
    let J' := principalSubsetRestriction A r f J
    let L := alternatingCechComplex U ((alternatingCechModulePresheaf).obj (J'.X n))
    let K := (alternatingCechDoubleFunctor U).obj J'
    let H := forget₂
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) AddCommGrpCat
    let e : (K.X 0).X n ≅ L.X 0 := L.extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat rfl
    let z := (H.map (alternatingCechZero U (J'.X n) ≫ e.hom))
      ((principalOpenSectionTransport A V (J.X n)).hom s)
    principalSubsetInsertOne A r f J n S
      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
        (homOfLE hl).op
        ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map (eqToHom (congrArg J.X he))).hom.app (op V) s)) =
      (H.map e.inv ≫ H.map (K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 n n (Int.zero_add n)))
        (Pi.single (S.val.orderEmbOfFin h) (z (S.val.orderEmbOfFin h)))
